handback.t:
Status: DONE_WITH_CONCERNS.
Commit: 73c1c9786 "feat(console): open any page by name (/ruflo go, palette, menu prompt)" on feat/console-nav (not pushed).
Tests: the new tests/find-by-name.spec.ts has 14 tests, RED on HEAD sources and 14/14 on head. nav, nav-state, commands-verbs, group-scheme, palette-view and key-labels all pass on base and head. `claude plugin validate plugins/ruflo-console` printed "Validation passed".
Rule, in order, first rule with any hit wins, and a tie at that rule gives null: exact id/key/label (a single letter is only ever the key), then retired name, then id prefix (3+ letters), then label prefix, then all typed words matching words of the id, label or retired names. So "catalog" gives market, "learn lab" gives neural, "lab" is ambiguous and gives null.
Also done: the `go` verb is in both the switch and VERBS. A name that matches nothing or is ambiguous answers "no page called ..." with close matches. The mission and catalog output now mention `/ruflo go missions` and `/ruflo go catalog`. The palette also lists a page when the query names it and puts a page whose label starts with the query first. The menu prompt already used viewOf, so it needed no change.
I also had to edit tests/commands-verbs.spec.ts so its help-line drift check treats `go` like `open`.
